card.name: The word of or all before a scope
card.fires_on: The small word "of" (or "all") right after a noun like space, treatment, set or College, where a full-scope phrase such as "all forms" or "of the set" comes next. Also fires on a few odd spots like bullet marks.

modes.label: of after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" after a head noun such as treatment, set, space or College.
modes.example: For the treatment<< of>> post-myocardial infarction patients

modes.label: all before a category
modes.description: The word "all" after treatment of or care for, introducing every member of a group.
modes.example: Rifampin is indicated in the treatment of<< all>> forms of tuberculosis.

modes.label: Stray spots
modes.description: Occasional bullet marks or partway through a name.

card.plain: It fires on little linking words like "of" and "all" that lead into a whole group or set of things.
